description: Scaffold a new Eligian presentation project from a starter template (blank, chapters, video, library) in a directory: main.eligian, layout, CSS, locales, package.json, plus the agent files of each client. client: claude, cursor, vscode, codex (default ["claude"]): claude gets .mcp.json and CLAUDE.md, cursor .cursor/mcp.json and .cursor/rules/eligian.mdc, vscode .vscode/mcp.json and .github/copilot-instructions.md, codex .codex/config.toml, and every client the AGENTS.md block; agents: false writes none. Existing agent files are merged: only the eligian server entry and the marked eligian block change. Each agent file is reported as written, updated, unchanged or refused (invalid JSON is left untouched). Existing starter files are refused unless force: true. The reply lists the files written and the next steps (npm install first).
name: eligian_init
